notes.title: From Roman Conqueror to US President: Explore Our New Game!
notes.content:
Hello, Roman Way fans!
We’re excited to announce our newest game, Election Tycoon: Trump vs Harris! If you enjoyed managing the Roman Empire, you're going to love the challenge of managing a modern political campaign. Build influence, sway states, and turn the U.S. map in your favor. It’s time to lead your candidate to victory!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170840/Election_Tycoon_Trump_vs_Harris/

notes.title: 1.10 Patch
notes.content:
[b]Features:[/b]
-Tutorial is redesigned.
-Mission system is redesigned.
-UI became more dynamic.
-Some bugs on UI are solved.
-New notifications are added.

notes.title: 1.05 Patch
notes.content:
[b]Features:[/b]
-Road placement system is remade.
-Bugs which prevent olive and olive oil production is solved.
-Wheat, olive and grape fields yield daily crop instead of 3 months of periods.
-Added new elements to UI.
